_README: Single source of truth for every clinic fact on the site. Leave a value empty ("") until it is VERIFIED — the build shows a clearly marked placeholder and prints a warning instead of inventing anything. Run `npm run build` after editing.
description: Modern dentistry centered around comfort, precision, and personalized care.

form._note: provider: 'netlify' (Netlify Forms, works when deployed on Netlify) or 'endpoint' (any service that accepts a JSON POST, e.g. Formspree or your own HIPAA-compliant backend). See README → Appointment form.

photos._note: Paths are relative to src/ (e.g. "assets/img/hero.avif"). Leave empty to show the art-directed placeholder.
